about: B73: every stand-in text read by the agent against its record (PRE-17, RSK-17). 'added' = a claim not in the data; 'wrong' = a claim that contradicts the data; 'leak' = prompt text echoed back; 'minor' marks small slips. 'checker' says whether the checker flagged the text (run 1 = blind, run 2 = after fixes; v2 texts were checked with run 3). The owner can spot-check these labels against results/standin-*.json.
